candidate: ODATA DC QR01, QR02 and QR03 (Mexico): operator-published facility coordinates on ODATA's locations map
decision: Use ODATA's own locations-map coordinate for each facility as that site's campus locator. QR04 is not used (held): the operator's current coordinate lies 422 m north of the named Google Maps place 'Data Center ODATA QR04' that ODATA's earlier facility page linked, and imagery shows different features at the two points.

source.extraction: The page's store-locator element carries an HTML-escaped data-locations JSON array of 12 ODATA facilities. The four entries with category 'Mexico' (ids 8621-8624) were parsed with Python json after html.unescape; the coordinates field is a single 'lat, lon' string, transcribed literally and split on the comma. No geocoder or map search was used.

facilities.address_as_published: Carretera Estatal 500, km 0+600, Localidad de Agua Azul, lots 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 and 29, El Marqués municipality, Queretaro, México

imagery_check.observation: The point falls at the north-west corner of a large flat-roofed building at the junction of the estate road and the north-south access road; a row of about two dozen generator or plant enclosures runs along the building's south side and a second fenced data-centre-type compound with a generator yard lies immediately south. Consistent with an operating data centre; the building is not labelled in the imagery.

facilities.address_as_published: GCRF+H4, 38188 Parque Industrial Amexhe, Gto., México

imagery_check.observation: The point falls on a small gatehouse/office annex at the south-west corner of a white-roofed building with rooftop plant and a row of generator enclosures along its south (road) side; a parking and laydown area lies to the west. Consistent with a data centre; the building is not labelled in the imagery.

facilities.address_as_published: Carretera Estatal 431 - Los Cues km.5.8 San Antonio de la Galera, Santiago de Querétaro, Qro., México

imagery_check.observation: The point falls on the perimeter road at the north edge of a large walled campus containing one long data-centre building flanked by rows of generator enclosures, two outdoor high-voltage substations to its east and an undeveloped graded plot to its west. It locates the campus edge near its north entrance, not a building.

excluded.earlier_operator_linked_place: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZeiffYzow68Jk87C7 (linked from ODATA's former QR04 facility page, captured in the 2026-07-21 packet) resolves to Google Maps place 'Data Center ODATA QR04', feature 0x842b530024a12323:0x25d741732ef97f32, !3d20.907398!4d-100.62028 (re-captured 2026-10-22, local odata-qr04-july-operator-linked-gmap.html)

Which point ODATA intends for QR04, and whether the northern plot is ODATA's, is not established.

consistency_checks.datum: not stated (web map; WGS 84 assumed by the map library, not asserted by the operator)
consistency_checks.coordinate_order: each string is 'latitude, longitude'; latitudes 20.5-20.9 N and longitudes -100.2 to -100.6 place all four in the Bajío between Querétaro and San Miguel de Allende, matching the addresses
consistency_checks.qr02_plus_code: The QR02 coordinate encodes (Open Location Code) to 75GXGCRF+M4; the published address code GCRF+H4 is the same 1/400-degree cell, two 1/8000-degree rows (about 28 m) south.
consistency_checks.areas: ODATA's Mexico page gives campus areas QR01 52,350 m2, QR02 22,373 m2 and QR03 275,000 m2; ODATA's May 2022 QR01 release gives the same 52,350 m2 campus and its April 2025 QR03 release about 275,000 m2.
